en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European riverside town. In the foreground is a calm riverbank with a small boat pulled up on shore and several people standing or playing near the water. Across the river stands a dense cluster of houses and buildings dominated by a large Gothic church with twin spires. Trees line parts of the shore and the overall style is early 20th‑century.
